parsed.title: Discussion on Tax Filing Assistance and Mini‑App Viability

topics.title: Tax filing assistance and related costs

claims.text: Paying 500 UAH to an acquaintance (Sveta) helped avoid larger penalties after a tax inspector initially approved incorrect declarations.
The tax filing process can be done in about an hour using Excel, with quarterly reports required.
Mistakes often stem from mismatched columns and incorrect subtraction rather than the tax calculation itself.
The calculator the author uses works only with a hryvnia‑based FOP; for foreign‑currency FOPs they had to convert each transaction using the day's exchange rate.

topics.title: Viability of a low‑cost cross‑platform mini‑app

claims.text: Web platforms are less profitable than Android/iOS because of poor SEO, no organic traffic, and strict paywalls that deter users.
A fast delivery cycle (under a week) and a cross‑platform stack like Flutter are considered essential for success.
There is doubt about any market for a 299 UAH app, especially since the password is stored plainly in local storage as a 100 % discount code.
The app claims to fetch USD/UAH rates every 5 minutes and perform calculations instantly in the browser, but the paid bundle actually contains only the password.
The project is described as a “free vibe‑code” experiment with no serious intent, inviting others to check the password or buy the app.

openQuestions.text: Is there a sufficient user base (at least ten people) willing to pay 299 UAH for the described mini‑app?
